cycles.method: No static count and no event counter (waived by the owner, sdk/approvals). On the unit with 480 locks and the crossfader sweeping, the CPU meter moved 0.2 points and no render was skipped (TESTING.md).

load.method: Hardware, not cfmeter: the owner's MKII on a development twin of base 0.7.4, 16 November 2026, package f38ae755 (the published one). Pattern B16 with a trig on every step of all eight MIDI tracks (channels off), playing, the crossfader swept through 12 positions between readings. Without the module, then with it and 480 scene locks: the frame guard's longest frame interrupt (34.0 % and 34.2 % of a frame) and the CPU meter (42.6 % and 42.8 %; idle taken as 100 less the meter), 10 readings each (TESTING.md).
